verdict.rationale: Missive's REST API is path-versioned at /v1, and its reference flags breaking changes inline and keeps superseded fields documented as legacy aliases. However, the evidence says outright that no versioning or deprecation policy page exists, so the policy half of the story is unmet. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy (timelines, sunset notice, support windows), any documented multi-version strategy beyond /v1, and independent corroboration of change-management practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
